params.caption: 🎮 Deus Ex creator Warren Spector hopes GTA 6 is "the last of its kind" Veteran designer Warren Spector, the mind behind Deus Ex, has reacted to GTA 6's reported $1 billion development cost by saying he hopes it stays a one-off. In his view, Rockstar's budget is not a business model other studios can or should copy, and he would rather see hundreds of smaller games and full employment across the industry. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 03:14 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 👥 @RockstarGames 💰 Mega-budgets or more smaller games?
